title: Other artists who recorded her songs
summary: Eddie Arnold and Ray Heatherton did "Thank You, Lord" and Dinah Washington recorded "What's the Matter, Baby".

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And then let me see what else. No, that was before Mahalia -- Eddie Arnold, I told you, did I Want to Thank You, Lord, with a choir, didn't I?
You may have told me a long time ago.

Eddie Arnold. You know the fellow that so many records sell? He did it for Victor. And Ray Heatherton, he did it with a choir, but for Decca. So I've had some good songs, you know. I mean good people do my material.
And then Dinah Washington made 'What's The Matter, Baby.' Wonderful record. And let me see what Sammy did. I'll have to bring those things over here so you can see them, you know. So now what else?
